prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one high-quality LANDSCAPE visual layout study for ZipperCrew's Babylon true-3D Corner Café game environment. This is a NEW CLEAN MINIMAL environment, not a production screenshot.
REFERENCES: image1 locks the CAST designs: Human B 'The Spark', orange Implementer robot, teal Reviewer robot. Keep robots essentially identical: broad black facial screens, cream plates, orange compact box head and antenna, teal angular tapered head and tablet. Human is original young ADULT male creative orchestrator with asymmetric copper shag, expressive knowing smile, plum irregular long overshirt with teal/lilac rolled sleeves, mustard shirt, dark trousers, cream/plum high tops, yellow notebook. Borrow ONLY a little looping curl softness from image2's hair, NOT its outfit/face/proportions. Human warm, lively, amused, listening and gesturing, most emotionally engaging member. All THREE at same physical scale, chunky stylized game anatomy. Exactly one of each, no duplicate characters.
ENVIRONMENT: aggressively restrained stylized modern workspace café, slightly spartan, warm through light and materials. Quiet ivory architecture, warm pale wood accents, single continuous matte warm gray/sand floor with almost no pattern. Cast are most saturated colorful objects. No carpet/rug anywhere. No clutter, bookshelves, posters, pendant lamp forest, plants collection, colored furniture trim, floor decals, cables, tiny decoration, academic props, decorative stage platform. At most ONE optional simple plant, preferably none. Not realistic architectural visualization; deliberate polished real-time 3D game meshes, softened edges, clean simplified material surfaces, game-scale readable forms. Fewer well-designed objects with breathing room.
REQUIRED ZONES: exactly TWO independent tidy visually light desks, each with one slim monitor naturally facing its participant, keyboard and at most one cup; a clearly usable chair behind each seated position. Correct participant/chair/desk/screen physical geometry, no figure beside the workstation pretending to use it. Human has one small plain table and a compact stool/chair, notebook/laptop. Compact coffee counter with ONE recognizable espresso machine and two cups, no menu wall or accessories. ONE simple slim off-white shared brief panel with faint restrained project blocks, mounted off-center on SIDE wall or small partition, never a giant classroom chalkboard. Open circulation connecting all stations, no furniture intersections.
STAGING: three characters visibly inhabit the room, not posed in a lineup. Implementer seated genuinely using desk with face at three-quarter angle still visible. Reviewer is calmly consulting tablet close to their own workstation/chair. Human engaged in small warm listening gesture or consulting notebook near small table. Keep facial expressions legible, do not turn backs to camera. Characters visually prominent, each roughly 20-28% of image height. Furniture sized for these characters, no gigantic desks.
CAMERA: consistent elevated three-quarter PERSPECTIVE game camera, 16:10-ish landscape, close enough to read cast, not strict orthographic/isometric, not remote dollhouse or architectural floor plan. Room occupies frame, no enormous blank floor foreground or outer margins. Full cast visible without props occluding faces. Soft directional daylight from a large simple window, crisp calm shadows and contact shadows shared by cast/furniture. Neutral warm grading, no haze, bloom or painterly brushwork. Clean game scene, not photoreal rendering or cozy illustration.
No UI, no floating role cards, no messages, no decorative lettering. Only a small plain top-left study label specified below, placed unobtrusively.
LAYOUT: Two freestanding pale oak desks form a LOOSE ASYMMETRIC inward-facing V, not a row: Implementer desk left-midground angled toward room center; Reviewer desk right-back turned roughly perpendicular to it. Keep generous central walking opening. Human small circular pale oak table in foreground right, Human standing just to its side gesturing toward Implementer. Both desk setups have thin warm-gray metal legs and elegant light bent-ply chairs. Back-left is a single LOW IVORY COFFEE CABINET with wood top, espresso machine and two cups. One broad window on rear wall. Shared brief is a slim landscape panel on RIGHT SIDE wall near Reviewer, not central backdrop. Walls mostly blank. No shelves, no plant, no pendants, NO RUG. Warm sun touches characters, quiet floor. Composition a compact conversational triangle; explicit empty circulation, not symmetrical classroom seating. Label '01 · Open Triangle'.
